input.free_text_description: This system is a search platform that serves User, Employer roles. The platform provides capabilities for address mapper, job mapper, user mapper. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a User, I want to use address mapper capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use event handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
